title: This Cat Was Mayor of an Alaska Town for 20 Years 🐱
description:

title: This Jellyfish Can't Die of Old Age 🪼
description:
Turritopsis dohrnii can reverse its life cycle and become a baby again when it is hurt or starving - making it, in theory, biologically immortal.

Sources: Natural History Museum London · The Conversation · Hasegawa et al., DNA Research 2022 · BBC Wildlife. Some scenes are dramatized; in the wild it still gets eaten.

Voice is synthetic.

title: Did Coca-Cola Have Cocaine? Yes - Here's the Full Story 🥤
description:
Coca-Cola's original 1886 formula contained cocaine from coca leaves. It was removed around 1903 - but Coke reportedly still uses cocaine-free coca leaf extract for flavor today.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine · The Coca-Cola Company (history) · New Georgia Encyclopedia · DEA notice, Federal Register (Stepan Company, Maywood NJ) · The New York Times (1988). Coca-Cola neither confirms nor denies the coca leaf extract.

Voice is synthetic.
